description_expanded: Sandy Daze - Pet-Friendly Vacation Rental on 30A with Private Hot Tub Favorite Features: - Pets Allowed - Private Hot Tub - 7 Minute Walk to Beach More about Sandy Daze: Welcome to Sandy Daze, your serene beachside escape along 30A in Santa Rosa Beach! This delightful, pet-friendly retreat on 30A features both a main house and a charming guest house, offering space, comfort, and privacy for families and groups alike. Just a seven-minute stroll from the pristine shores, Sandy Daze provides a blend of fun and relaxation, with a private hot tub perfect for unwinding after sun-filled days. Inside, you’ll find an inviting open-concept layout, ideal for gatherings. The main house includes a spacious living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a foosball table to keep everyone entertained. Each bedroom is comfortably furnished, and the guest house offers extra accommodations for added privacy. Outdoors, enjoy the tranquil hot tub, lounge areas, and lush surroundings that invite peaceful afternoons and starlit evenings. With its convenient location near Santa Rosa Beach's dining, shopping, and local attractions, Sandy Daze offers a memorable coastal escape designed for relaxation and entertainment! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: Queen Bed & Shared Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 2: 2 Twin over Twin Bunks & Shared Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 3: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 4: Queen Bed & Shared Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 5: Queen Bed & Shared Bathroom with Shower.
